title: Certified Production promotion startup evidence hardening

phases.objective: Make Certified Production release-cut startup proof use one hermetic repository-owned test environment while preserving exact candidate identity and authoritative Production provenance.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A CI or Certified Production Release Cut Validation run invokes the structured runtime startup evidence harness for an exact candidate SHA.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The startup proof either passes with bounded structured evidence for the exact candidate or fails closed with a classified first failure, without consuming inherited provider, database, GitHub, or Production secret payloads.
steps: Build a child startup environment from an explicit safe inherited-variable allowlist.
Override required startup authentication values with repository-local synthetic fixtures.
Run deployment manifest validation and generation for the exact candidate.
Start the runtime through the Hostinger-compatible root entrypoint.
Verify the runtime exposes authoritative Production deployment provenance even when inherited branch metadata is stale.
Persist bounded structured startup evidence and classify the first failure without relying on unrestricted job logs.
assertions: Inherited database, provider, GitHub, runtime persistence, and Production branch-lock secret values do not cross the startup-test environment boundary.
PATH remains an allowlisted process-execution context value and is not treated as application environment selection.
NODE_ENV and deployment identity metadata remain explicit inputs while the root entrypoint establishes authoritative Production provenance.
The root entrypoint generates the manifest with Production provenance and establishes the process-local authoritative branch lock.
A broken hermetic startup environment is classified as certification_contract_error before runtime stages execute.
A server startup failure is classified as runtime_startup_failure and emitted through bounded structured evidence.
Production is not mutated and no deployment, SQL, migration, provider call, grant, or credential payload read is executed by this contract.

phases.objective: This patch changes repository-local certification behavior only and does not require live Production execution to prove the merge contract.
Keep inherited secrets, stale branch metadata, invalid startup-test contracts, and runtime startup failures fail-closed with deterministic classification and bounded evidence.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The startup evidence harness receives inherited secret-like environment values, stale deployment branch metadata, or an invalid startup-test environment contract.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Unsafe inherited values are excluded or replaced, stale branch metadata cannot override authoritative Production provenance, and invalid startup certification fails closed with bounded classified evidence before any Production mutation.
steps: Construct the repository-owned startup-test environment from the explicit inherited-variable allowlist.
Reject or replace inherited credential and branch-lock payloads while retaining required process execution context such as PATH.
Exercise invalid startup-test contract and runtime startup failure paths.
Exercise stale inherited branch metadata through the Hostinger-compatible root startup path.
Verify deterministic failure classification, bounded diagnostics, and authoritative Production provenance.
assertions: Inherited provider, database, GitHub, persistence, authentication, and Production branch-lock secret payloads do not cross the test-environment boundary.
PATH remains a safe execution-context allowlist entry and does not select staging or Production.
An invalid startup-test environment contract prevents runtime stages from executing and is classified as certification_contract_error.
A runtime startup failure is classified without exposing inherited secret payloads.
Stale inherited main or feature branch metadata cannot replace the authoritative Production provenance established by the root entrypoint.
No Production deployment, SQL, migration, provider mutation, grant, or credential payload read is authorized or executed by this journey.

phases.objective: No deployment or live Production canary is authorized by this patch.
This contract grants no Production mutation, promotion execution, deployment, SQL, migration, provider, credential, or grant authority.
